items.title: Unmasking misogyny: How a Malayalam YouTube channel weaponises science against women
items.summary: In July 2026, during a debate on 24 News’ Thammil Thammil about whether women should face restrictions on what they wear, a woman panellist posed a question that cut to the heart of the argument: If women’s clothes provoke sexual assault, what explains the rape of children and elderly women? Muhammed Ameer, an ‘educator’ and one of the prominent faces of the Malayalam digital platform Unmasking Anomalies (UA), had an answer. “Consider”, he said, “the amount of sexual imagery men are exposed to every day, from hoardings and advertisements to models.” A man sees a sexually exposed woman and becomes sexually frustrated. Just as someone who cannot shout back at a boss might take their anger out on someone at home, he argued, sexual frustration can be taken out on a different target. This, Ameer said, was “frustration-aggression theory”. When another panellist objected that this did not explain why women should change what they wear, Ameer was emphatic. “This is a psychological theory,” he asserted. “It’s not me saying this.” It is an effective way to make an argument, enough to make the person sitting across from you in a debate pause and reconsider what they can immediately challenge.

items.title: TG SAFE  suspends licences of four Hyderabad eateries over food safety violations
items.summary: The Telangana Standards Authority for Food and Essential Drugs (TG SAFE) has suspended the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) licences of four Hyderabad food establishments and ordered them to stop operations after inspections found serious hygiene violations. The action followed a special inspection drive by eight teams comprising food safety officers and police personnel. The checks were conducted at nine restaurants, hostels and other establishments in response to consumer complaints. The four establishments whose licences were suspended are Madhapur Bawarchi in Ayyappa Society, The Spice Kitchen in Kukatpally, Mataam Al Yamani Arabian Restaurant in Tolichowki and Annapurna Caterers in Chandanagar. TG SAFE said it would share their details with food delivery platforms, including Swiggy and Zomato, to facilitate their delisting until their licences are restored. Inspectors reported cockroach infestations and rat droppings, unhygienic kitchens, clogged drains, damaged flooring and improper separation of vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. They also found synthetic food colours, smoke-stained walls and missing medical examination records for food handlers. Al Kare
